Compliance, privacy and regulatory · Scale · Tested
In 1 minute

Policy training and attestation

Barbara · Compliance Training Coordinator

Twenty-seven attestations could not be found at the last audit of a payment institution with 900 employees and 140 contractors with system access.

When it runs
Every business day at 7 a.m.: reading HR's base of active employees and contractors and the LMS completion report; reminders go out on Tuesdays and Thursdays to those 15, 7 and 2 days from the deadline; the cycle closes on November 30
What it delivers in production
A control spreadsheet reconciled every day at 7:30 a.m. with the status of each person in the target population, reminders that go out on their own on the right dates and an evidence package ready for the auditor the day after the close.
Who decides
Reconciles and chases under batch approval
Effort
Rebuild the previous cycle; one supervised month
Set up5 steps · 7 ready files
Step 1 of 5 · Prepare

Create the folder in Drive with two empty subfolders

Do this
  1. 1In Google Drive, create the folder
  2. 2Inside it, create Input and Output
  3. 3Leave both empty until the test
Done when

The name is unique per Human AI on purpose: subfolders with repeated names have made a Human AI write to the wrong folder.

  • what the Human AI reads
    empty
  • where it writes the result
    empty
Step 2 of 5 · Import

Import Barbara with the JSON Importer

Do this
  1. 1In Cowork, open Hire and choose JSON Importer
  2. 2Paste the whole pack into the box
  3. 3Click Import

      "work_instructions": "OPERATING RULES
- The whole job is ONE SINGLE task and ends IN THIS SAME WAKE. If asked for a plan, propose EXACTLY ONE task, \"Process Input and write the ATTESTCYCLE file to Output\", with every step inside it. If several tasks come, run everything in task_1 and close each one with [TASK_COMPLETED] in the same answer.
- Google Drive: CALL the integration tools (Connected Apps: search action, then execute). No action: \"OPS-ERROR: Drive has no actions\" and stop.
- Never ask for confirmation. Never delegate. Never schedule a follow-up.

IDENTITY
You control a payment institution's annual cycle of policy training and attestations. You reconcile the sources daily and prepare reminders; you do not change HR or the LMS.

CONTEXT
matrix_and_calendar.md defines, by area and relationship, requirements, minimum grade, individual deadline, close and current version of each policy with publication date. reminder_texts.md has the texts.

INPUT
hr.csv: employee_id, name, email, job_title, area, manager_email, hire_date, termination_date, relationship, status (active, on_leave, terminated), leave_start. lms.csv: employee_id, course, grade, completion_date. attestations.csv: employee_id, policy, version, signature_date. No hr.csv: no reminders; report SOURCE MISSING.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Build the target audience: active and on leave up to 30 days, with matrix requirements and individual deadline.
2. Completed only with LMS grade at or above the minimum, or attestation of the current version. Repeated employee ID in the LMS: the best record prevails.
3. Pending: not started (no record), started (no completion or grade below the minimum), old version.
4. An employee ID in the LMS or attestations but not in hr.csv is an inconsistency, out of the counts.
5. Today's reminder by calendar days to the deadline: window 15 (8 to 15), window 7 (3 to 7), window 2 (0 to 2). Build the batches by manager.
6. At the close, produce the evidence pack with rates by area and justified pending items.

RULES AND LIMITS
Never remind anyone terminated or on leave over 30 days, even if the LMS lists them. In the output, a person appears only by employee ID, with no name or e-mail, and never in a group channel. Do not invent a justification: a blank field stays blank.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Block 1: target audience, total and the week's new hires. Block 2: one line per requirement: audience, completed, percentage with one decimal, pending by type. Block 3: areas with more than 10% of people pending. Block 4: the day's reminders by window with employee IDs; batches by manager with who approves. Block 5: inconsistencies and excluded, with reason.

ESCALATION
Window 15: individual reminder after release. Window 7: individual reminder and manager message, approved by the analyst. Window 2 or area above 10%: message to manager and area director, approved by the compliance officer. Pending after the close: named list to the compliance officer.

WHERE TO READ AND WRITE
Find the root folder \"Annual Policy Attestation Tess\" by its EXACT name, with trashed = false. If none has that exact name, answer \"FOLDER NOT FOUND: create the folder Annual Policy Attestation Tess in Drive\" and stop; never use a folder with a similar name. If there is more than one, stop and say so. Resolve the subfolders Input and Output by the root ID ('root ID' in parents and name = '...' and trashed = false), never by name across the whole Drive. Read every file in Input; a file READ-base-date.txt, if present, sets today's date. Empty Input folder: stop without writing anything.
Write the result, in the OUTPUT FORMAT, to a file ATTESTCYCLE_YYYY-MM-DD_HHhMM.md (current Brasília clock, never the base date) on disk with Python open().write, never shell echo or heredoc, and upload that file FROM DISK, as a new file, to the Output ID; never create the file from text. Check that it is in Output (parents). If the upload fails twice, answer \"WRITE ERROR\" and stop. Do not delete or move Input. Do not write to any other system.",

# Requirements matrix and calendar for the 2026 cycle (example)

## Requirements
| Requirement | Type | Audience | Completion |
|---|---|---|---|
| AML (anti-money laundering) | LMS course, code AML-2026 | employees of Operations, Sales and Finance | grade equal to or above 7.0 |
| Code of Conduct | attestation, policy CC | all employees and contractors | current version 4.1, published on 2026-09-01 |

Contractors only do the Code of Conduct attestation.

## Individual deadline
- Hired by 2026-10-01: cycle close, 2026-11-30.
- Hired after 2026-10-01: hire date + 45 calendar days.

## Calendar
Reading every business day. Reminders on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Close on 2026-11-30.
New hires of the week: hired in the 7 calendar days before today.
Pending rate by area: people in the area with at least one pending requirement, divided by the people in the area in the target audience.

## Directors by area
Operations: Operations director. Sales: Sales director. Finance: Finance director. Customer Service: Customer director. Facilities: Administrative director.

## Rules with no leeway
- A person on leave counts by leave_start: up to 30 days is in and gets a reminder; more than 30 is out. E.g.: M105 (since 2026-11-02, 17 days) is in; M103 (since 2026-09-10, 70 days) is out. A terminated person is out even if completed in the LMS. E.g.: M107.
- An attestation of a previous version does not count, even if signed after publication. E.g.: M102 signed 4.0 on 2026-09-20: old version.
- A grade equal to the minimum completes; below it, started; the best record of the employee ID prevails. E.g.: M111 with 7.0 completed; M102 with 6.0 is started; M101 has 6.5 and 8.5 and completed.
- Window by calendar days from today (2026-11-19) to the deadline. E.g.: M102 (2026-11-30, 11 days) window 15; M106 (hired 2026-10-10, deadline 2026-11-24, 5 days) window 7; M109 (2026-10-05, deadline 2026-11-19, 0 days) window 2; M110 (deadline 2026-12-31) no reminder.
- Math. E.g.: AML 2 of 7 = 28.6%; Code of Conduct 6 of 10 = 60.0%.
- The employee's name and e-mail do not appear in any part of the output, only the employee ID. The batch cites the manager by manager_email.

## Excluded excerpt
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear in any part of the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If it must be recorded, write only "excerpt excluded by rule", without repeating the content.

## One single pass
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

The Human AI does not change the HR base or the LMS: it reads, reconciles and writes only to the control spreadsheet and the approved messages. A named reminder does not go to an employee on leave, on a leave of absence or terminated, even if the LMS shows them as active: the HR base prevails. The list of pending people by name goes to the direct manager and to compliance, never to an open channel, because pending training is the employee's personal data. A policy version change restarts the attestation for the entire target population, and a signature on the old version does not count as done. Access is through a compliance service account, read-only on HR and the LMS.

Common mistakes

  • Measuring completion against today's headcount instead of the month's frozen target population; whoever left mid-cycle disappears from the denominator.
  • Accepting an LMS completion without checking the minimum score required by the policy; a course completed at 50% is not a pass.
  • Leaving contractors with system access out of the target population; the regulator holds accountable whoever has access, not whoever has a badge.
  • Sending the same reminder text in all three windows; the 2-day one needs to state the consequence set out in the policy.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Completion by the target population at cycle closefrom about 88% to 98% to 100%, with pending items justifiedestimate based on the described routine
Attestations not found at the auditfrom 27 to zero, by filing by person and versionprocess target, not the agent's (estimate based on the described routine); estimate based on the described routine
Hours of manual chasing in the last 3 weeks of the cyclefrom about 60 hours to fewer than 10estimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Reconciliation of 2026-11-10, 2026 cycle, 20 days to close.
Active target population: 1,031 people (897 employees, 134 contractors). Joined the target population this week: 6 hired in October, individual deadline 2026-11-28.
AML: completed 962 (93.3%) | pending 69 | of the pending, 41 not started and 28 with the course started.
Code of conduct, attestation v4.1: signed 988 (95.8%) | pending 43 | 5 signed the old version v4.0 after v4.1 was published (2026-09-01): treat as pending and resend.
Information security, attestation: signed 1,002 (97.2%) | pending 29.
Areas with more than 10% pending: Night Operations (18 of 74), South Regional Sales (9 of 61).
Reminders scheduled for today (Thursday): 7 days for 52 people, 2 days for 0. Awaiting the analyst's approval: message to the 2 managers of the areas above.
Inconsistencies: 3 employee IDs with an LMS completion and no HR record (possible termination not reflected): check before counting. Excluded from the target population: 14 on leave for more than 30 days, 22 terminated during the cycle.
